preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the renounceOwnership() function to permanently give up ownership, or call lock(uint256 time) to temporarily transfer ownership to address(0) for a specified duration. This will disable all onlyOwner functions including fee adjustments, max transaction limits, and swap/liquidity controls, potentially freezing contract functionality.
